name: codetopo
description: Domain-blind code graphs for AI agents: symbols, calls, blast radius, proof-checked snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: Queryable code graphs: symbols, calls, blast radius.
interface.longDescription: codetopo indexes a source repository once into a local graph database, then answers structural questions as data over MCP: find symbols, see what calls what, measure the blast radius of a change, walk the neighborhood of a node, find the path between two modules, and export a snapshot bound to a tamper-evident audit chain that can be verified later. It is domain-blind by design: structure only, no scores or opinions about what the code means. The server runs locally over stdio and parses your code; it never executes it and never modifies it.
defaultPrompt: Use codetopo to index this repository and show what calls this function.
Use codetopo to find the blast radius of changing this symbol.
Use codetopo to show how these two modules are connected.
